metadata.coordinate_note: Coordinates are the synthetic CSV x_rum/y_rum metric coordinates expanded by half a RUM size. No WGS84 transform was applied.
metadata.feature_note: One feature per district/subdistrict group. Bounding polygons are rectangular envelopes of RUM cells.
metadata.manual_patch_note: B4/B5 background east sign was treated as manually corrected to southeast in notes/final compiled CSV; outlines are location-only and unaffected by velocity sign.
